test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six girls named P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a straight line. All are facing the north direction. U sits third to the left of R. S sits third to the right of Q. U sits second to the left of Q. T is not the immediate neighbour of U. What is P's position in the line?

options.text: Third from the extreme right end
Second from the extreme left end
Third from the extreme left end

solution:
According to the given information,

1) U sits third to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ecefdb8f8e7c0ca6847eee8ddebdbe26879b44bfc45bc6546b3964b9f03c89d.png] 

2) U sits second to the left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ee4d2cdf6e244e37a3e0c1ad3d4cca697c96d98f29eba23e806ff5b7af3c61a.png] 

3)&n
bsp;S sits third to the right of Q. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51f104665f1df508aabfbdbbe79bb9575637b5ab0fcf36afed12ffce3b711dd4.png] 

4) T is not the immediate neighbour of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f5daecd263df77a43fcf3085829bc6b3bc285ba293b9ad64344213eba1a212c.png] 

Here, we can see that P is sitting second from the extreme left end.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Second from the extreme left end"**.
